Bharath Sankar is the Founder & CEO of TMB Tech, a software and technology solutions company that builds business applications, ERP systems and mobile apps for real businesses.

Contact Bharath Sankar Visit TMB Tech

About Bharath Sankar

Bharath Sankar founded TMB Tech to help businesses simplify operations, manage information efficiently and move their workflows into reliable digital systems.

At TMB Tech, Bharath Sankar designs and builds the products personally: the database, the backend API, and the web and mobile screens that shop staff and customers actually use. Every product is set up, hosted and supported directly by TMB Tech, and can be customized to fit the way a business already works.

Software development expertise

End-to-end development, from the data model to the screen.

Business applications & ERP

Billing, inventory, GST and accounts in LedGo ERP, plus management software for gas agencies, jewellery shops and two-wheeler service centers.

Mobile applications

Android apps such as GasOne, JB One and the SharkPanda browser.

Web applications

Online ordering and catalogue sites for shops, built with Blazor and ASP.NET Core, React and Firebase.

Backend APIs & databases

REST APIs and database-driven systems, with SQLite and Firebase, that keep the web and mobile apps in step.

Custom software

Software built to a business's exact requirement, or an existing TMB Tech product customized to fit.

AI projects

AI-powered projects built for businesses, from the first idea to a working product.

Vision and mission

Mission

To build practical software that helps businesses simplify operations, manage information efficiently and move their workflows into reliable digital systems.

Vision

Dependable software that fits the way businesses actually work, so no business has to change how it works to use it.
